integrity: All proofs are stated with exact normalization, domain, and quantifiers. Finite software checks supplement the analytical proof and no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The profile covers the regular Euclidean n-gon for all integers n>=3 and interior pedal points. Identifying the scalar with the n-fold pedal similarity requires the nondegeneracy hypotheses of the underlying prior theorem; boundary values are continuous extensions. Historical priority under older alternate terminology is not ruled out.
title: Chebyshev angular rigidity of regular-polygon pedal contraction
